author: CNET
description:
Another day, another few thousand folds… 

We’re folding Apple’s iPhone Duo over and over — 900 times an hour — to test the durability of its hinge. Watch the livestream every Monday through Friday at 1pm ET to 5pm ET (10am PT to 2pm PT) on YouTube where the CNET team will answer questions while indulging your ASMR needs. #foldaphone #iphoneduo #apple #testing #cnetlabs
title: Fold-A-Phone Day 4: We’re Over 117K Folds!
